title: Cross-Ontology Composition
description: Compose CASE/UCO core with CAC, legalproc, cryptoinv, and exactly one foundational upper profile (gUFO preferred for CAC). Dual BFO+gUFO typing is an anti-pattern.
mission: Stop investigators and agents from inventing parallel hierarchies when a concept already lives in an extension or upper profile.

Location.notes: Location is not an ObservableObject. Use GeoSPARQL Feature/Geometry only when this profile is combined with the geosparql upper profile.

recipe_skeleton.summary: Domain-first typing; one foundational profile per graph; extensions compose.
steps: Pick the domain classes first (CASE/UCO + CAC + legalproc/cryptoinv as needed).
Choose one foundational profile: gUFO for CAC, BFO only when the rest of the graph already uses BFO.
Add PROV-O / OWL-Time / GeoSPARQL / FOAF / ORG only where they add queryable structure.
Declare intended profiles with PROF metadata; record validation separately.
Never owl:sameAs an uncertain identity; never dual-type BFO+gUFO.
